 Page No.# 2/3
 Before
 Honourable Mr. Justice Manish Choudhury
 Order

Date : 18.12.2023 Heard Mr. S. Borthakur, learned counsel for the petitioner and Mr. N. Goswami,
learned Junior Government Advocate, Assam for the respondent nos. 1 - 3.

The petitioner has instituted the instant writ petition assailing the action on the part of the respondent authorities in freezing his bank account bearing no. 30334063796 maintained Nalbari Branch of State Bank of India, purportedly without complying to the provisions of Section 102, Code of Criminal Procedure, 1973.

It is the case of the petitioner that the bank account has been purportedly freezed in connection with Chandmari Police Station Case no. 325/2023 registered for offences 120B/406/420, Indian Penal Code.
Though the petitioner was arrested in connection with the said case, he was not named in the First Information Report.
As Mr. Goswami, learned Junior Government Advocate has appeared and accepted notice on behalf of the respondent nos. 1 - 3, no formal notices need to be issued to the said respondents.

Mr.
Borthakur, learned counsel for the petitioner shall, however, furnish requisite nos. of extra copies of the writ petition along with annexures, to Mr. Goswami within 2 [two] working days from today.

The petitioner shall take steps for service of notice upon the respondent no.
Page No.# 3/3 4 by registered post with A/D within 2 [two] working days from today.
Mr. Goswami shall obtain the instructions from the respondent no. 3 as regards compliance with the provision of Section 102, CrPC in freezing the bank account of the petitioner.
The prayer for interim relief will be considered on the next date of listing.
